 Medicinal Properties 
 Shri Gopal Taila is an effective Ayurvedic oil that has property to heal illness concerned with impaired vata, kapha and pitta doshas, having properties of a health tonic and aphrodisiac agent. 
 This Ayurvedic oil is very useful in various neuro-muscular conditions. It helps a lot in improving memory , enhances the retention power and intelligence on its application over scalp and forehead. Helps to improve brain functions and memory power. This is useful in psychotic conditions. It is also very efficient in providing strength to nerves, muscles and blood vessels. 
 This is a very suitable Ayurvedic remedy to deal with sexual problems such as erectile dysfunction, premature ejaculation, improving sexual stamina and strength. 
 It is an effective oil to use in pregnant woman which is applied gently over abdomen (without any massage), providing strength to abdominal muscles. Also it provides relief from pain and cramps happens during menstrual cycle.

Shri Gopal Taila (Oil) – Benefits, Usage & Indications 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Vatavyadhi 26/289-299 
 Shri Gopal Taila (Oil) is an Ayurvedic oil used to treat the various neuro-muscular conditions, improves brain and memory power etc. The oil is also used to treat ED problem. It is a versatile herbal oil which offers the various health benefits. It balances the tridoshas – Vata, Pitta and Kapha in body.

 The above herbs are used to prepare decoction – 3.072 liters
